hooks.command:
IN=$(cat)
NAME=$(printf '%s' "$IN" | jq -r '.name')
. "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/lib/resolve-project-dir.sh"
DIR="$JENGA_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/worktrees/$NAME"
SID=
if [ -z "${CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID:-}" ] && [ -z "${JENGA_CHECKLIST_SESSION_ID:-}" ]; then SID=$(printf '%s' "$IN" | jq -r '.session_id // empty'); fi
"$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/scripts/create-task-worktree.sh" "$DIR" "$NAME" ${SID:+--session "$SID"} >/dev/null || exit $?
"$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/scripts/install-worktree-commit-guard.sh" "$DIR" "$NAME" 1>&2
echo "$DIR"
